descriptionChirho: The grapevine plant (Vitis vinifera), used both literally for viticulture and figuratively for Israel/people; all 6 languages use a single consistent lexeme throughout (eng 'vine', spa 'vid', hin 'दाखलता', arb 'كَرْمَة', kor '포도나무', swa 'mzabibu'), with cluster splits arising solely from grammatical variation (article, preposition, conjunction, possessive suffix, number).
